title: Our best deal ever
author: Geoff Shullenberger
content:
Dear reader,

We hope you have been enjoying _Compact_ 's free newsletter and are ready for
the full experience. For a limited time, we are offering our [best deal
ever](https://www.compactmag.com/a-year-for-10) for new subscribers: a year of
full access for just $10.

Over the past year, _Compact_ has repeatedly set the agenda, with blockbuster
essays from [Jacob Savage](https://www.compactmag.com/article/the-lost-
generation/), [Clifford Ando](https://www.compactmag.com/article/the-crisis-
of-the-university-started-long-before-trump/), [Helen
Andrews](https://www.compactmag.com/article/the-great-feminization/), and much

Our paid subscribers make all of this possible. Please help us keep it coming
by becoming one of them.

Read everything we publish in the next year for just $10 by following this

Sincerely,  
Geoff
